purpose: Teach: 楓/出逢い/隠れ家/どんぐり/硬貨/大砲/散髪/ブルーベリー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと楓の名所に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go see the maple leaves with Dad, shall we?
lines.style: Warm, maternal invitation. Soft opening. Gentle downward inflection at the end—a mother checking in, not commanding. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんとママの出逢いの話して下さい
lines.en: Mom, can you tell me the story of how you and Dad first met?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not performing. Quiet wonder in the voice. Lean forward slightly—he's asking something that matters to him. Small breath before the question.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママのキッチンが私の隠れ家なのよ
lines.en: Sho, my kitchen is my little refuge, you know.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy. A mother speaking half to herself, half to her son. Slight pause before 'refuge'—she's choosing the word carefully. Tender nostalgia underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとどんぐり拾いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went acorn-picking with Dad today!
lines.style: Bright, eager. Quick clip at the opening—he wants her to hear his excitement. Open vowels. Natural child's enthusiasm, not forced. Trailing lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが古い硬貨をくれたわね
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa gave you that old coin, remember?
lines.style: Gently reminiscing. Soft pause after the opening. As if she's fondly remembering along with him. Slower pace—savoring the detail. Quiet, not lost-in-thought but present-in-memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと大砲のお話したよ
lines.en: Mom, I told Grandpa a story about cannons!
lines.style: Eager but quieter than his previous turn—he's proud of what he shared with Grandpa, not just what he did. Slight shyness underneath the excitement. Soft landing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと散髪屋さんに行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, shall we take you to the barber with Dad?
lines.style: Maternal, matter-of-fact but tender. Practical warmth. Light, easy tone—stating something routine but said with care. The voice of a mother who makes small moments feel safe.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ブルーベリーパイ食べたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat blueberry pie.
lines.style: Simple, direct, but not demanding. Soft wanting in the voice—he's asking, not insisting. Small boy's voice. Quiet contentment. Slight wonder that blueberry pie is even a possibility.
